violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Establishment cleaned and sanitized deli slicer during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Establishment marked containers during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

ROP fish was observed thawing in an intact package. ROP seafood product must be completely removed from ROP package before thawing. Fish voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the two door unit and on the prep unit in the kitchen. Gaskets must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/06/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. No employee was present during time of inspection with Food Safety Manager Training. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2025
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the prep unit. Gaskets must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/27/2025
The door to the dining room toilet room is not self-closing. Toilet room doors must be self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 06/27/2025
